newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian Gorenje says 96 net profit jumps 90 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian Gorenje says 96 net profit jumps 90 pct.

text.p: Slovenian unlisted domestic appliances producer Gorenje said on Wednesday its 1996 net profit surged to 412 million tolars ($2.5 million) from 217 million a year ago.

"Mainly internal measures -- increasing productivity, cutting costs, production of new appliances and focusing on markets of countries in transition -- increased our profit" chief executive Joze Stanic, told Reuters.
The company said its 1996 turnover rose 1.85 percent to 74.9 billion tolars from 73.5 billion the previous year, when the company's turnover was the fourth largest among domestic firms.

Gorenje, which exports 95 percent of its products mainly to western European markets, has about 70 percent of Slovenia's market and forecast a further rise in its market share. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
